title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 27, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.5 (Peaked November 27, 2026 at 02:04 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 286 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

The Sun looks mostly quiet, with no clear sunspots and a dark coronal-hole-like region visible on the right side.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
